explanation: First normal form requires each column value to be single-valued. When a fact can occur multiple times, it should be represented in related rows rather than as a repeated list inside one column.

options.text: Keep the column and add a rule that entries must use commas consistently
Split each phone number into a separate related row
Store the phone numbers in a longer text field
Move the customer name into a separate table

prompt: A company stores one row per customer order. In the column `phone_numbers`, some rows contain one number, while others contain several numbers separated by commas. Which change best brings the table into first normal form?
reviewConcept: Single-valued attributes and repeating groups belong in related rows, not in one field.

source.title: Normalization and other Data Modeling Methods
